web.title: Death and funeral of Pope John Paul II
web.description:
## Death
On 2 April 2005, [Joaquín Navarro-Valls](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Joaqu%C3%ADn_Navarro-Valls), director of the [Holy See Press Office](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Holy_See_Press_Office), announced that John Paul II had died that day, at 84 years old, at 21:37 ( [CEST](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Central_European_Summer_Time), UTC+2 ) in his private apartment. [[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Death_and_funeral_of_Pope_John_Paul_II#cite_note-8) He died at 84 years and 319 days of age, 46 days before his 85th birthday.

He died after 26 years and 162 days of papacy.
